objective.prompt: Build one complete outfit from the catalog. Apparel size is M. Shoe size is 9. Include one top, one bottom, and one pair of shoes when the catalog has that role. A layer is optional. At most one accessory. One item per role. Train, validation, and test are disjoint shopper profiles. Fitness on a split is the mean subjective score across that split's shoppers. Fixture rows have no product URL and are not purchasable.

payload.styling_notes: A balanced campus-ready outfit with one clean top, one versatile bottom, coordinated size-9 shoes, and a single accessory for polish without overcomplicating the look.
